title.narrative: Strengthening Amazonian Indigenous Women in Ucayali, Junín, Amazonas, San Martín, Loreto and Lima

description.narrative:
The project seeks to strengthen the leadership, participation, and advocacy of Amazonian Indigenous women connected to the vicariates of Puerto Maldonado, Pucallpa, Jaén, and San José del Amazonas, as well as of Shipibo-Konibo women from the Cantagallo community in Lima. Through an intercultural, synodal, and rights-based approach, the initiative promotes recognition of the leading role of Indigenous women in defending their rights, caring for the Amazon, and building a more participatory and inclusive Amazonian Church. The project will work closely with the five regional offices of the Centro Amazónico de Antropología y Aplicación Práctica (CAAAP) in Ucayali, Junín, Amazonas, San Martín, and Loreto. It will strengthen knowledge management and a training-of-trainers process to expand the territorial reach of experiences and lessons learned in recent years, develop a shared indigenous women's agenda and strengthen strategic communications and advocacy capacities.
The initiative will also strengthen Indigenous women’s organizational and advocacy capacities so they can participate more actively in church, community, and public spaces related to the defense of collective rights and the protection of their territories.
A key component of the project is communication and knowledge management. Building on previously systematized experiences, the project will produce a conceptual note and training materials on gender from the perspective of CAAAP and Amazonian Indigenous women. It will also generate communication content that amplifies Indigenous women’s voices, proposals, and experiences, strengthening their role as spokespersons and their presence in regional and national dialogue spaces. Overall, the project aims to consolidate sustainable Indigenous women’s leadership, strengthen collaboration across Amazonian territories, and highlight women’s essential role in caring for our Common Home.
